concerns: One MAJOR defect confirmed: dashboard.js:1284 reads `p.candidate_executor ?? p.executor` but shadow.ts emits the field as `candidate_executor_used`. The executor column in the shadow variants strip will always display '—' for all tasks. Fix: change line 1284 to `p.candidate_executor_used ?? p.candidate_executor ?? p.executor ?? null`. All 565 tests pass. All other acceptance criteria pass.

findings.description: Shadow variants strip executor column always shows '—'. dashboard.js:1284 reads `p.candidate_executor ?? p.executor` but shadow.ts recordShadowRunCompleted emits the field as `candidate_executor_used` (see shadow.ts lines 70, 93, 132, 141). Neither fallback key matches the payload, so the executor value is always null. Fix: `p.candidate_executor_used ?? p.candidate_executor ?? p.executor ?? null`.
